chunks: He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad ibn Ali al-Sayrafi reported to me, he said: Abu al-Husayn al-Abbas ibn al-Mughairah al-Jawhari narrated to us, he said: Abu Bakr Ahmad ibn Mansoor al-Ramadi narrated to us, he said: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us, he said: My father informed us, from Mayna the client of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud who said:

We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) on the night of the jinn delegation. The Messenger of Allah said to us: Which of you will follow me? They fell silent. Then he said: Which of you will follow me? They fell silent. Then he said: Which of you will follow me? They fell silent. Then Ali (peace be upon him) said: I will, O Messenger of Allah. So he set out until when he came to al-Hajun, he drew a line for me with his foot, then said: Sit within it and do not leave until I come to you. Then he went until he disappeared from my sight. I began hearing screams, and fear grew intense in me. Then he came to me while I was sitting and said to me: Stand up. I said: O Messenger of Allah, I was truly worried about you, and I heard intense screaming. He said: That was the fighting between the Muslim jinn and the polytheist jinn. I said: Who was upon the truth? He said: The party of Muhammad. And he said to me: Indeed, had you been with me, you would not have been able to bear that, nor I. Indeed, there is no one from my community fit for this matter other than me and you.

key_terms.أطرقوا: They fell silent, lowered their gazes in hesitation
key_terms.وفد الجن: Delegation of the jinn, a well-known Prophetic event
key_terms.يصلح لهذا الأمر: Fit for this matter/affair — referring to leadership

ai.seo_question: What happened on the night of the jinn delegation with the Prophet and Ali?
ai.summary: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud narrates the incident of the night when the Prophet (SAWW) went to meet the jinn delegation near al-Hajun in Mecca. The Prophet asked his companions three times who would accompany him, and only Ali (AS) volunteered. While waiting, Ali heard intense fighting between Muslim and polytheist jinn. The Prophet then told Ali that no one in his community was fit for this mission except the two of them, implicitly indicating Ali's unique status as his successor.
